b.sound: The beech tree is a mighty tree with smooth, grey bark.
The beech tree is a mighty tree with bright, yellow bark.
Beech trees grow slowly and can live for up to 400 years.
Beech trees grow slowly and only live for about 10 years.
The seeds of a beech tree are called beechnuts.
The seeds of a beech tree are called acorns.

feedback.end: Oak trees are sturdy trees that can live up to 1,000 years old! Their bark is greyish brown, with large grooves that run along the trunk.
Oak tree seeds are called acorns. They are a squirrel’s favourite snack!

atoms.a: The seeds of oak trees are called beechnuts.
